Our results reveal a stem cell-specific Golgi complex configuration that facilitates efficient niche signal reception and tissue renewal, which is compromised in the aged epithelium.

title: A c-di-AMP receptor mediates epithelial adhesion of Lactiplantibacillus plantarum
summary_zh: 研究确定RwpL为L. plantarum的c-di-AMP受体，介导上皮粘附，并作为转录抑制和激活因子。RwpL通过结合到目标基因启动子下游抑制wxlA转录。
summary_en: The study identifies RwpL as a c-di-AMP receptor in L. plantarum WCFS1, mediating epithelial adhesion and functioning as both a transcription inhibitor and activator. RwpL inhibits wxlA transcription by binding downstream of its TSS.
insights: 创新点：确定RwpL为c-di-AMP受体
方法亮点：研究RwpL在转录调控中的作用
关键发现：RwpL抑制wxlA转录
insights_en: Novelty: Identification of RwpL as a c-di-AMP receptor
Method highlight: Study of the role of RwpL in transcriptional regulation
Key finding: RwpL inhibits wxlA transcription
abstract: Cyclic di-adenosine monophosphate (c-di-AMP) is a crucial second messenger used by bacteria to mediate bacterial-host interactions. However, its roles in Lactiplantibacillus plantarum remain poorly understood. Here, we identify RwpL, which consists solely of an HTH domain, as a c-di-AMP receptor in L. plantarum WCFS1. RwpL mediates epithelial adhesion of L. plantarum WCFS1 and functions as both a transcription inhibitor and activator, with transcriptional output determined by the position of its binding site relative to the transcription start site (TSS) of target genes. Specifically, RwpL inhibits wxlA transcription by binding downstream of its TSS, thus reducing WxlA interaction with fibronectin, a matrix protein on the surface of intestinal epithelia. In contrast, RwpL activates transcription of the matrix-degrading metalloprotease gene mmpL by recruiting the sigma factor RpoA upstream of its TSS. Notably, elevated c-di-AMP levels diminish RwpL binding affinity for both DNA and RpoA, thereby reversing its regulatory functions and enhancing L. plantarum adhesion to host epithelial cells. Together, our findings uncover a dual and reversible regulatory mechanism through which c-di-AMP modulates bacterial-host interactions in L. plantarum. Researchers identified a c-di-AMP receptor that reversibly controls gene expression and host cell adhesion in Lactiplantibacillus plantarum, revealing how this bacterial signal molecule regulates interactions with intestinal epithelial cells.

title: Clonal memory of cell division in humans diverges between healthy haematopoiesis and acute myeloid leukaemia
summary_zh: 人类造血干细胞显示细胞分裂的克隆记忆。与健康造血相比，急性髓系白血病中克隆记忆较低，揭示细胞异质性。
summary_en: Human hematopoietic stem cells display clonal memory of cell division. Compared to healthy hematopoiesis, clonal memory is lower in acute myeloid leukemia, revealing cell heterogeneity.
insights: 创新点：克隆记忆在健康与白血病中的差异
方法亮点：高分辨率体外工具
关键发现：细胞异质性
insights_en: Novelty: Divergence of clonal memory between healthy and leukemic hematopoiesis
Method highlight: High-resolution ex vivo tools
Key finding: Cell heterogeneity
abstract: Clonal memory, a cellular property inherited across at least two divisions, is a key driver of cell heterogeneity. To uncover its roles in human haematopoiesis, we develop high-resolution ex vivo tools that track both division and fate commitment of individual primary human haematopoietic stem and progenitor cells (HSPCs). We show that human HSPCs display a clonal memory of division, as cells descending from the same ancestor cell divide synchronously over multiple generations. In parallel, HSPCs inherit a clonal memory of fate commitment, independently of lineage identity. Both forms of clonal memory persist over at least two divisions, across different HSPC commitment stages and cell culture conditions. In contrast, malignant haematopoiesis exhibits lower synchronicity, revealing a disruption of clonal memory in leukaemic cells. Epigenetic remodelling using a bromodomain inhibitor partially restores the clonal memory in division in leukaemic HSPCs, highlighting the plasticity of this trait and its potential for therapeutic modulation. Our findings position clonal memory as a key regulator of human haematopoietic stem cell behaviour. Demonstrating that clonal memory can be modulated opens avenues for tuning cell heterogeneity in healthy and pathological tissues. Healthy blood stem and progenitor cells display synchronised division across generations — a form of clonal memory lost in AML. A bromodomain inhibitor partially restores it, revealing a potential epigenetic vulnerability in leukaemia.

title: Function-specific epistasis shapes evolutionary trajectories towards antibiotic resistance
summary_zh: 研究揭示抗生素耐药性进化轨迹受功能特异性上位性调控。通过实验发现，特定细胞功能扰动导致进化路径多样化。
summary_en: The study reveals that antibiotic resistance evolution is shaped by function-specific epistasis. Experimental findings show that perturbations to specific cellular functions lead to diverse evolutionary paths.
insights: 创新点：功能特异性上位性影响耐药性进化轨迹
方法亮点：通过实验验证上位性作用
关键发现：特定功能扰动导致进化路径多样化
insights_en: Novelty: Function-specific epistasis influences resistance evolution trajectories
Method highlight: Experimental validation of epistatic effects
Key finding: Specific functional perturbations lead to diverse evolutionary paths
abstract: Pre-existing mutations can influence subsequent evolution by constraining or opening evolutionary pathways through epistatic interactions. In some cases, global epistasis allows evolutionary pathways to be predicted from the fitness of the genetic background alone. In other cases, idiosyncratic epistasis makes evolution less predictable. Here, we show that the evolution of antibiotic resistance is highly repeatable, following a common path across most genetic backgrounds. However, a minority of genetic backgrounds exhibit evolutionary trajectories that significantly deviate from this common path. Rather than being predictable from global epistasis, these deviations are modulated by function-specific epistasis: perturbations to specific cellular functions lead to novel evolutionary trajectories towards resistance. Using tightly controlled robotic evolution experiments, we quantitatively analyzed resistance trajectories for three clinically relevant antibiotics across multiple genetic backgrounds, including hundreds of Escherichia coli gene-deletion strains and several clinical isolates from urinary-tract infections. We show that disrupting distinct sets of cellular functions alters evolutionary trajectories for specific drugs and across different drugs, and we identify genetic changes defining these alternative trajectories. Importantly, this function-specific epistasis often slows down resistance evolution. Some of these effects can also be induced by small-molecule inhibitors of the identified targets, suggesting that function-specific epistasis can be exploited to improve drug treatments.

title: Decadal sink-source shifts of forest aboveground carbon since 1988
summary_zh: 研究整合卫星观测与深度学习模型，重建1988年以来全球森林地上碳记录。发现湿润热带和北方森林逐渐转变为碳源。
summary_en: The study integrates satellite observations with deep learning models to reconstruct global forest aboveground carbon records since 1988. It finds that moist tropical and boreal forests have progressively transitioned into carbon sources.
insights: 创新点：深度学习模型重建碳记录
方法亮点：多源卫星数据整合
关键发现：森林碳源变化趋势
insights_en: Novelty: Deep learning model reconstructs carbon records
Method highlight: Integration of multi-source satellite data
Key finding: Forest carbon source transition trend
abstract: Abstract Forest ecosystems are vital to the global carbon cycle, yet their long-term aboveground carbon (AGC) dynamics remain uncertain. Here, we integrate multi-source satellite observations with probabilistic deep learning models to reconstruct a harmonized, uncertainty-aware global forest AGC record from 1988 to 2021 at 0.25 ∘ . We find that, although global forests sequestered 6.2 PgC, moist tropical and boreal forests have progressively transitioned toward carbon sources since the early 2000s. Tropical AGC variability became increasingly negatively correlated with atmospheric CO 2 growth rates (r = – 0.63 in 2011–2021), suggesting tropical forests increasingly modulate the global carbon cycle. In the Brazilian Amazon, the contribution of intact forests to the year-to-year variations in AGC losses increased from 33% in the 1990s to 76% in the 2010s. Our findings highlight the vulnerability of carbon stocks in key biomes and provide a benchmark to track emerging sink-source shifts under anthropogenic climate change.

title: Cerebrospinal fluid biomarkers reveal transdiagnostic synaptic dysfunction across major psychiatric disorders
summary_zh: 研究通过质谱技术量化脑脊液中的低丰度突触蛋白。发现精神分裂症谱系障碍患者突触蛋白水平显著降低。
summary_en: The study quantifies low-abundance synaptic proteins in cerebrospinal fluid using targeted mass spectrometry. It finds that synaptic protein levels are significantly reduced in schizophrenia spectrum disorders.
insights: 创新点：脑脊液生物标志物揭示突触功能障碍
方法亮点：质谱技术量化突触蛋白
关键发现：精神分裂症谱系障碍突触蛋白水平降低
insights_en: Novelty: Cerebrospinal fluid biomarkers reveal synaptic dysfunction
Method highlight: Mass spectrometry quantification of synaptic proteins
Key finding: Reduced synaptic protein levels in schizophrenia spectrum disorders
abstract: Synaptic dysfunction is increasingly recognized as a core feature of psychiatric disorders, yet fluid biomarkers that reflect such changes in vivo are lacking. Here, we applied targeted mass spectrometry to quantify low-abundant synaptic proteins in cerebrospinal fluid from 672 individuals with anorexia nervosa, attention-deficit/hyperactivity disorder (ADHD), bipolar disorder (BD), schizophrenia spectrum disorders (SCZ + ), and healthy controls. Synaptic protein levels were markedly reduced in SCZ + , with intermediate reductions in BD and ADHD. Using a data-driven approach to model transdiagnostic contrasts-psychotic experience, cognitive and functional impairment-a shared two-biomarker signature emerged: elevated LAMP1, a phagolysosomal marker, and reduced NPTX2, a synaptic activity marker which inhibits complement-dependent synapse elimination. Combining this ratio with polygenic scores improved diagnostic classification. Key findings were extended to an independent cohort at first-episode psychosis. These results support synaptic pathology as a measurable and transdiagnostic feature across several psychiatric disorders and highlight the potential of integrating fluid and genetic biomarkers.

title: Tracking the catastrophic collapse of hybrid exciton-phonon order in a quantum material
summary_zh: 研究揭示量子材料中混合激子-声子秩序的灾难性崩溃。发现低频模式在有序状态下出现，指示激子-声子耦合。
summary_en: The study reveals the catastrophic collapse of hybrid exciton-phonon order in a quantum material. A low-frequency mode emerges only in the ordered state, indicating exciton-phonon coupling.
insights: 创新点：揭示量子材料秩序崩溃
方法亮点：低频模式分析
关键发现：有序状态下的激子-声子耦合
insights_en: Novelty: Revealing the order collapse in a quantum material
Method highlight: Low-frequency mode analysis
Key finding: Exciton-phonon coupling in the ordered state
abstract: Abstract Revealing the hidden interactions that bind electronic and lattice components of cooperative quantum order is central to sculpting new states of matter. This challenge is epitomized by the charge density wave material 1 T -TiSe 2 , where photoexcitation disrupts its presumed hybrid exciton-phonon order: the electronic component collapses within femtoseconds, while the periodic lattice distortion persists, challenging the definition of hybrid order. Here we resolve this paradox by uncovering a low-frequency mode (~0.13 THz) that emerges only in the ordered state and signals exciton-phonon coupling. This mode is consistent with a locked phason, a collective excitation arising when excitonic and lattice degrees of freedom share a coupled potential landscape. At a critical photoexcitation threshold, the collapse of the excitonic order flattens this potential, causing the locked phason to disappear, the charge density wave phonon to selectively overheat, and the surviving lattice distortion to become a trapped non-thermal remnant.

title: Split intron-exon system for circular RNA synthesis
summary_zh: 研究引入分裂内含子-外显子系统进行环状RNA合成。设计克服现有技术限制，实现高效环状RNA合成。
summary_en: The study introduces a split intron-exon system for circular RNA synthesis. The design overcomes limitations of current techniques, enabling efficient circular RNA synthesis.
insights: 创新点：分裂内含子-外显子系统合成环状RNA
方法亮点：克服现有技术限制
关键发现：高效环状RNA合成
insights_en: Novelty: Split intron-exon system for circular RNA synthesis
Method highlight: Overcoming limitations of current techniques
Key finding: Efficient circular RNA synthesis
abstract: Ribozyme-based approaches have been extensively employed for in vitro circular RNA (circRNA) synthesis. However, several critical challenges are impeding the progress in this field, including the relatively low ribozyme utilization efficiency, limited synthetic flexibility, and complicated downstream purification procedures. Here, we introduce a split intron-exon (SIE) system for circRNA synthesis by physically separating the ribozyme from its substrates. This design ensures efficient circRNA synthesis by overcoming the inherent limitations of current ribozyme-based techniques, in which each ribozyme can only catalyse the synthesis of at most one circRNA molecule. Moreover, the SIE system enables the efficient synthesis of both unmodified and chemically modified circRNAs. Furthermore, the recyclability and immobilization of the ribozyme within the SIE system reduce reaction impurities and improves circRNA enrichment and yield. Overall, the SIE system holds great potential to advance the diversification and large-scale development of circRNA therapeutics. Current ribozyme-based methods enable efficient circular RNA synthesis but suffer from inflexibility. Here, the authors introduce the split intron-exon (SIE) system, which separates ribozymes from substrates to facilitate the efficient production of modified circular RNAs, optimizing production process.

title: Facial expression discrimination emerges from partially overlapping neural subspaces of detection and identity
summary_zh: 研究探讨人类大脑如何解码面部表情。以猕猴为模型，验证六种表情的行为对应性。利用人工神经网络模型解释猕猴行为，发现广泛训练的神经网络与猕猴图像级行为最佳匹配。
summary_en: This study investigates how the human brain decodes facial expressions. Using macaques as a model, the behavioral correspondence across six expressions is verified. Artificial neural network models explain macaque behavior, finding that broadly-trained ANNs best match macaque image-level behavior.
insights: 创新点：猕猴作为人类面部表情识别的动物模型
方法亮点：利用人工神经网络模型解释猕猴行为
关键发现：广泛训练的神经网络与猕猴图像级行为最佳匹配
insights_en: Novelty: Macaques as an animal model for human facial expression recognition
Method highlight: Using artificial neural network models to explain macaque behavior
Key finding: Broadly-trained ANNs best match macaque image-level behavior
abstract: How does the human brain decode facial expressions? Addressing this question requires models that tightly link neural representations to behavior. Here, we first establish rhesus macaques as an animal model of human facial expression discrimination, showing strong behavioral correspondence across six expressions. To probe underlying neural mechanisms, we leverage artificial neural network (ANN) models of the ventral stream as explicit computational hypotheses explaining macaque behavior. Despite action unit–based stimulus generation and high classification accuracies of face-optimized models, broadly-trained ANNs best match macaque image-level behavior. Interestingly, ANNs showing the strongest behavioral alignment are those whose internal representations best resemble macaque inferior temporal (IT) representational geometry. Neural recordings further reveal that early IT responses best predict our measured expression judgments and exhibit a heterogeneous coding architecture in which identity and expression information coexist along partially overlapping dimensions. Together, these findings constrain mechanistic accounts of facial expression discrimination in high-level visual cortex. How the brain supports facial expression perception remains unclear. Here, the authors show that macaques are a good model of human expression perception and that early high-level visual cortex activity links face identity and expression.

title: Human cortex organizes dynamic co-fluctuations along the sensorimotor-association axis
summary_zh: 研究揭示人类大脑功能网络沿感觉运动-关联轴组织动态共波动。发现低幅波动对网络组织有贡献，与感觉运动网络、关联系统和边缘系统相关。
summary_en: This study reveals that human functional brain networks are organized along the sensorimotor-association axis, with low-amplitude fluctuations contributing to network organization, related to sensorimotor networks, associative systems, and limbic system.
insights: 创新点：揭示低幅波动对网络组织的重要性
方法亮点：研究区域共波动与感觉运动-关联轴的关系
关键发现：低幅波动与不同大脑系统相关
insights_en: Novelty: Revealing the importance of low-amplitude fluctuations in network organization
Method highlight: Investigating the relationship between regional co-fluctuations and the sensorimotor-association axis
Key finding: Low-amplitude fluctuations are related to different brain systems
abstract: Human functional brain networks, originating from coherent fluctuations in brain activity, are organized along a hierarchical axis. However, how this stable hierarchical architecture emerges from time-varying co-fluctuations remains unknown. Existing dynamic analyses have primarily focused on high-amplitude co-fluctuations, largely overlooking the contribution of lower-amplitude activity. Here, we investigated the amplitude-dependent configurations of regional co-fluctuation. We found that these patterns were hierarchically aligned with the sensorimotor-association (SA) axis: sensorimotor networks are preferentially expressed during high-amplitude co-fluctuations, associative systems prevailed during intermediate amplitudes, and limbic system preferentially engaged in low-amplitude states. This amplitude-stratified hierarchy underwent developmental refinement from childhood to adulthood and adaptively reconfigured under naturalistic stimuli. Replicated across four independent datasets including 7 T fMRI, these findings uncover a fundamental principle whereby the brain’s hierarchical architecture is actively preserved through a structured, amplitude-dependent cascade of functional co-fluctuations. Our framework bridges dynamic coordination and stable architecture, demonstrating how the brain balances external processing with internal cognition through amplitude-stratified interactions. This study reveals that amplitude-stratified co-fluctuations in brain activity transit from sensorimotor to association dominance. These patterns matured between childhood to adulthood and reconfigured under naturalistic stimuli, linking dynamic activity to stable network organization.

title: Metal pre-intercalation promotes water-mediated proton-coupled electron transfer in layered δ-MnO2 for aqueous pseudocapacitive energy storage
summary_zh: 研究δ-MnO2伪电容器的电荷存储电容增强机制。发现金属预嵌入保持层间水，支持通过MnO2+H2O+e-⇌MnOOH+OH-反应的可逆反应进行质子耦合电荷存储。
summary_en: This study investigates the mechanism of enhanced capacitance in δ-MnO2-based pseudocapacitors. It is found that metal pre-intercalation preserves interlayer-confined water, which supports proton-coupled charge storage via the reversible reaction MnO2 + H2O + e- ⇌ MnOOH + OH-.
insights: 创新点：金属预嵌入对层间水的保护作用
方法亮点：实时原位光谱监测结构-功能关系
关键发现：质子耦合电荷存储的机制
insights_en: Novelty: The protective effect of metal pre-intercalation on interlayer water
Method highlight: Real-time in situ spectroscopic monitoring of structure-function relationships
Key finding: The mechanism of proton-coupled charge storage
abstract: Abstract The charge storage capacitance of δ-MnO 2 -based pseudocapacitors stems from a combination of bulk cation intercalation/deintercalation and surface proton chemisorption/desorption. Here, we investigate the mechanistic origins of the enhanced capacitance in δ-MnO 2 with pre-intercalated Cu 2+ . To this end, we synthesize Au-core/δ-MnO 2 -shell nanostructures with and without Cu 2+ pre-intercalation, enabling real-time in situ spectroscopic monitoring of structure-function relationships during electrochemical cycling. Transition metal pre-intercalation preserves interlayer-confined water, which in turn supports proton-coupled charge storage via the reversible reaction of MnO 2 + H 2 O + e - ⇌ MnOOH + OH - . This confined water forms a hydrogen-bonded network that lowers the energy barrier for proton transport within the interlayer space. Similar mechanistic transition is also evident in δ-MnO 2 systems pre-intercalated with other transition metal ions, such as Co 2+ and Mg 2+ . By tuning the MnO 2 shell thickness, we decouple the relative contributions of proton- and cation-driven processes, revealing that proton intercalation delivers a markedly higher specific capacitance than cation intercalation. Electrolyte-dependent studies further reveal that Cu 2+ pre-intercalation promotes OH - transport within the interlayer space while preserving proton accessibility at active sites. These findings suggest that proton-coupled transport may offer further increases in charge storage performance in pseudocapacitors.

title: Photonic scaffolds as ultrahigh-openness on-chip hollow-core waveguides for quantum photonics and optofluidics
summary_zh: 研究新型芯片空心波导，采用空气为主体的支架结构，实现高达80%的包层开放度，同时保持与全封闭波导相当的光学损耗。
summary_en: This study introduces a novel on-chip hollow-core waveguide using a scaffold membrane geometry predominantly composed of air, achieving an ultra-high cladding-openness fraction of up to 80% while maintaining optical losses comparable to fully enclosed waveguides.
insights: 创新点：空气为主体的支架结构实现高开放度
方法亮点：结合反共振约束和分段结构中的Bloch模式形成
关键发现：高精度3D纳米打印和光学表征验证
insights_en: Novelty: Air-predominant scaffold structure achieves high openness
Method highlight: Combination of anti-resonant confinement with Bloch-mode formation in a segmented structure
Key finding: High-precision 3D nanoprinting and extensive optical characterization verification
abstract: On-chip hollow-core waveguides enable strong light-matter interaction in gases and liquids with high integration density, yet limited side access to the core restricts their use in diffusion-driven processes. We introduce a distinct class of on-chip hollow-core waveguides that confines light in a scaffold membrane geometry composed predominantly of air, reaching cladding-openness fraction up to 80% while maintaining optical losses comparable to fully enclosed waveguides. Light guidance in the photonic scaffold is enabled by the combination of anti-resonant confinement with Bloch-mode formation in a segmented structure. High-precision 3D nanoprinting, extensive optical characterization and a resonator-based theoretical model confirm the guiding principle and loss behavior. We demonstrate application relevance through enhanced molecular diffusion, highly integrated optofluidic spectroscopy, and efficient single-photon transmission enabled by the open scaffold geometry and air-dominant guidance.

title: Forests in protected areas worldwide face increased thermal pressure from urbanization
summary_zh: 研究全球保护区森林面临的城市化热压力。发现自1990年以来，城市与保护区之间的平均距离缩短了三分之一以上，城市化对保护森林的压力增加约2.56%。
summary_en: This study investigates the increased thermal pressure on protected forests worldwide from urbanization. It is found that since 1990, the average distance between urban areas and protected areas has decreased by over one-third, increasing urban pressure on protected forests by about 2.56%.
insights: 创新点：量化城市化对保护区森林的热压力
方法亮点：使用卫星数据比较保护区内外温度
关键发现：城市化导致保护区森林热压力增加
insights_en: Novelty: Quantifying the thermal pressure on protected forests from urbanization
Method highlight: Using satellite data to compare temperatures within and outside protected areas
Key finding: Urbanization increases thermal pressure on protected forests
abstract: Abstract Protected areas (PAs), thermal refuges for biodiversity, are increasingly under pressure from urbanization. Gaps remain in how urbanization worldwide influences the thermal environment of PAs. Here, we quantify urban pressure on protected forests as a distance-weighted built-up intensity. The thermal impacts of urban pressure are assessed by comparing satellite-derived mean land surface temperature (LST) and thermal extremes inferred by the 90th-percentile maximum LST of protected forests within and beyond a 5-km buffer zone outside urban boundaries. We show that the global mean distance between urban areas and PAs has decreased by over one-third (12.82 km) since 1990, increasing urban pressure on protected forests by about 2.56%. Urbanization alters thermal environments by elevating LST, and the frequency and intensity of thermal extremes, with the highest impact on annual mean daily LST (0.63 °C) and intensity of thermal extremes (0.81 °C) in tropical protected forests. We highlight the need to integrate urban development and conservation planning to support biodiversity conservation and sustainable development.

title: Scalable irradiance-adaptive electrochromic shading for photothermal regulation
summary_zh: 研究可扩展的辐照度自适应电致变色遮阳系统，实现动态光热调节。系统在热带户外暴露下表现出大光学对比度和稳健的操作稳定性。
summary_en: This study introduces a scalable, solar-powered, irradiance-adaptive electrochromic shading system for dynamic photothermal regulation. The system exhibits large optical contrast and robust operational stability during tropical outdoor exposure.
insights: 创新点：实现动态光热调节的系统
方法亮点：系统在热带户外暴露下的稳定性
关键发现：系统在农业环境中的应用潜力
insights_en: Novelty: A system for dynamic photothermal regulation
Method highlight: Stability of the system during tropical outdoor exposure
Key finding: Potential application in agricultural environments
abstract: Abstract Agricultural production in hot climates requires effective photothermal regulation under fluctuating solar conditions. Electrochromic devices offer a promising route for dynamic photothermal regulation, yet their deployment in real-world agricultural environments remains limited by challenges in scalability, durability, and system-level integration. Here, we show a scalable, solar-powered, irradiance-adaptive electrochromic shading system that autonomously regulates photosynthetically active radiation and suppresses ultraviolet and near-infrared radiation under fluctuating outdoor conditions without external energy input. The electrochromic devices exhibit large optical contrast and robust operational stability during tropical outdoor exposure. Field deployment in tropical agriculture reduces crop-surrounding temperature by up to 3.8 °C while maintaining optimal conditions for photosynthesis. Consequently, crops grown under electrochromic shading exhibit 23.7–64% increases in vitamin C, total sugar, and pigments, together with a 235% increase in biomass yield compared with a conventional shading system. Cultivation modeling further reveals substantial cooling-energy savings across diverse climate zones during hot seasons.

title: Coastal flooding at predictable hours
summary_zh: 研究潮汐主导的沿海系统中的周期性洪水。发现潮汐成分与太阳日的相位锁定导致高潮潮汐在一致的地方时间重复出现。
summary_en: This study investigates recurrent flooding in tidally dominated coastal systems. It is found that phase-locking of tidal constituents and constituent pairs with the solar day causes peak tides to recur at consistent local times set by regional tidal propagation.
insights: 创新点：潮汐主导的沿海系统中周期性洪水的预测性
方法亮点：使用潮汐记录量化洪水事件的时间
关键发现：高潮潮汐在特定小时的一致性
insights_en: Novelty: Predictability of recurrent flooding in tidally dominated coastal systems
Method highlight: Quantifying the intraday timing of coastal flood events using tide-gauge records
Key finding: Consistency of peak tides at specific hours
abstract: Flooding is typically perceived as a sudden and unpredictable hazard. Here, we show that recurrent flooding can occur at highly predictable times in tidally dominated coastal systems. This predictability stems from phase-locking of tidal constituents and constituent pairs with the solar day, causing peak tides to recur at consistent local times set by regional tidal propagation. Using tide-gauge records from the United States and the United Kingdom, we quantify the intraday timing of coastal flood events and show strong clustering at specific hours, particularly where semidiurnal or mixed tides dominate. For example, floods in Boston cluster around noon and midnight, whereas in southern California they occur in the morning. Sites with stronger non-tidal variability show weaker clustering. This temporal predictability extends beyond nuisance flooding to larger consequential events involving inundation, road closures and infrastructural damage, highlighting opportunities for anticipatory risk communication, emergency planning and time-sensitive coastal adaptation.

title: Tailoring d–p orbital hybridization of single-atom Cu-N2S sites for enhanced photo-Fenton reaction
summary_zh: 研究通过精确调整单原子Cu-N2S位点的d-p轨道杂化来增强光Fenton反应。发现强d-p轨道杂化提高了HOMO能级，并通过独特的反-d带中心原理调节Cu位点的吸附亲和力。
summary_en: This study investigates enhancing photo-Fenton reactions by precisely tailoring the d-p orbital hybridization of single-atom Cu-N2S sites. It is found that strong d-p orbital hybridization elevates the HOMO energy level and regulates the adsorption affinity of single-atom Cu sites via a unique anti-d-band-center principle.
insights: 创新点：通过d-p轨道杂化增强光Fenton反应
方法亮点：密度泛函理论计算揭示机制
关键发现：独特的反-d带中心原理调节吸附亲和力
insights_en: Novelty: Enhancing photo-Fenton reactions through d-p orbital hybridization
Method highlight: Density functional theory calculations reveal the mechanism
Key finding: A unique anti-d-band-center principle regulates adsorption affinity
abstract: Although single-atom catalysts (SACs) are emerging as advanced heterogeneous catalysts for Fenton-like reactions, enhancing their performance by precisely tailoring d–p orbital hybridization remains challenging. Herein, single Cu atoms with a unique Cu-N2S asymmetric coordination structure are designed and fabricated to catalyze photo-Fenton reactions. Density functional theory (DFT) calculation reveals that strong d–p orbital hybridization elevates the HOMO energy level and promotes splitting of d-orbital energy levels, thereby regulating the adsorption affinity of single-atom Cu sites toward H2O2 via a unique anti-d-band-center principle. Consequently, the Cu-N2S single sites exhibit unique photo-switching behavior, transforming the inactive sites into Fenton-active ones under light irradiation, thereby enabling sustained and enhanced generation of hydroxyl radicals for efficient degradation of various organic micropollutants. The developed photo-Fenton system achieves 98.9% removal of sulfamethoxazole, along with broad pH applicability (pH 3-11), high tolerance for complex water matrices, and exceptional durability for long-term operation. This work highlights the critical role of single-atom coordination symmetry in modulating electronic orbital structures, providing an avenue for the rational design of advanced Fenton-like catalysts. In this study, the authors report that asymmetric Cu–N2S coordination enables robust photo-Fenton activity for pollutant degradation over a broad pH range, driven by d–p hybridization and an anti-band-center effect that boost H2O2 activation.

title: In situ structure of the poxvirus portal complex
summary_zh: 研究揭示痘病毒门户复合体结构。采用冷冻电镜技术。结果显示六聚体由E8、E6和L3蛋白组成。
summary_en: This study reveals the structure of the poxvirus portal complex. Cryo-electron tomography was used. The hexameric complex consists of E8, E6, and L3 proteins.
insights: 创新点：首次解析痘病毒门户复合体结构
方法亮点：冷冻电镜技术应用于病毒结构解析
关键发现：E8、E6和L3蛋白为痘病毒mRNA释放所必需
insights_en: Novelty: First structural determination of the poxvirus portal complex
Method highlight: Cryo-electron tomography for virus structure analysis
Key finding: E8, E6, and L3 proteins are essential for poxvirus mRNA release
abstract: Abstract Poxviruses are a family of large, complex double-stranded DNA viruses that includes human pathogens such as variola—the cause of smallpox—and monkeypox. Recent outbreaks of mpox underscore the need for a better understanding of poxvirus biology 1,2 . Poxvirus assembly is a conserved process that involves the formation of a biconcave core inside the membrane of the maturing virus 3,4 . Here we use cryo-electron tomography combined with subtomogram averaging and structure prediction to determine the structure and composition of the portal complex—a pore that spans the core wall—in vaccinia virus, the prototypical poxvirus. The hexameric complex consists of the E8, E6 and L3 proteins, which are conserved across poxviruses and essential for mRNA release during the establishment of infection 5–7 . E6, which is also required for virus assembly 8–10 , forms the central chamber of the portal and interacts with the surrounding core wall. A hexamer of E8 attaches to the exterior side of E6. L3, a target of TRIM5α-mediated restriction 11 , binds as a hexamer of dimers to the interior side. Furthermore, the viral helicase D5, which is required for genome release from cores 12 , associates with cytoplasmic cores during infection by docking onto the exterior E8 rim of the portal complex. We propose that the portal complex represents an attractive target for the development of anti-poxvirus therapeutics.

title: How fruit flies track the edge of odour plumes
summary_zh: 果蝇利用空间记忆追踪气味羽流边缘。大脑神经元编码空间记忆。实验证明气味引导导航。
summary_en: Fruit flies use spatial memory to track the edge of odour plumes. Brain neurons encode spatial memory. Experiments demonstrate odour-guided navigation.
insights: 创新点：发现果蝇使用类似记忆导航工具
方法亮点：虚拟现实实验研究果蝇行为
关键发现：大脑神经元编码空间记忆引导行为
insights_en: Novelty: Discovery of similar memory-guided navigation tool in fruit flies
Method highlight: Virtual reality experiments to study fruit fly behavior
Key finding: Brain neurons encode spatial memory guiding behavior
abstract: Ants and bees are known to use spatial memories to navigate to fixed locations, such as a nest. Virtual-reality experiments in which Drosophila fruit flies follow fictive odour plumes now show that these insects use components of a similar memory-guided navigational toolkit to track the edge of a plume towards its source. Neurons in the fly’s brain encode a spatial memory that guides them back to the plume.

title: Amazonian earthwork survey indicates ancient population was much larger than thought
summary_zh: 亚马逊地区考古发现古代人口远超预期。激光扫描揭示大量人造土堆。研究挑战传统人口密度观点。
summary_en: Archaeological discoveries in the Amazon indicate a much larger ancient population than previously thought. Laser scanning reveals numerous human-made earthworks. The study challenges traditional population density views.
insights: 创新点：揭示亚马逊地区古代人口规模
方法亮点：使用激光扫描技术进行考古调查
关键发现：古代文明对现代环境有深远影响
insights_en: Novelty: Revealing the ancient population size in the Amazon region
Method highlight: Use of laser scanning technology for archaeological surveys
Key finding: Ancient civilizations had a profound impact on modern environment
abstract: Aerial laser-scanning data reveal that, from ad 100 to ad 300, an area spanning less than 3% of the Greater Amazonia region probably supported between 1.25 million and 3 million people and contained more than 20,000 human-made earthworks. These findings call for a re-evaluation of the density of pre-colonial Amazonian populations and the influence these civilizations had on present-day tropical soils and forests. The Aquiry civilization comprised between 1.25 million and 3 million people around AD 100–300.

title: Over 20,000 precolonial earthworks in the Southwest Amazonia
summary_zh: 西南亚马逊发现超过2万座前殖民地土堆。激光雷达数据揭示分布。研究丰富亚马逊历史。
summary_en: Over 20,000 precolonial earthworks found in southwestern Amazonia. LiDAR data reveals distribution. The study enriches the history of Amazonia.
insights: 创新点：发现大量前殖民地土堆
方法亮点：使用激光雷达数据进行考古调查
关键发现：土堆分布揭示亚马逊历史
insights_en: Novelty: Discovery of a large number of precolonial earthworks
Method highlight: Use of LiDAR data for archaeological surveys
Key finding: Distribution of earthworks reveals the history of Amazonia
abstract: Abstract Numerous geometric earthworks have been found in southwestern Amazonia, evidence of a monument-building precolonial civilization 1–3 . This knowledge has contributed to the discussion about the deep history and the precolonial urbanism of Amazonia, its sociocultural contexts and its environmental legacy 2,4–8 . Estimates of the geographical extent and population size of the forest civilization have remained weak, because the detection of earthworks has been almost exclusively limited to deforested areas where vegetation does not completely hide the structures. Here we used canopy-penetrating LiDAR data over 4,430 km of flight to define the geographical distribution and quantity of earthworks in this region better. On the basis of both existing data and our LiDAR documentation, we show that this cultural area alone contains as many earthworks as previously estimated for the whole of Amazonia. We also propose that the total human population of the area in 100–300 ad was 1.25–3 million people. If similar results are found elsewhere in Amazonia, the total precolonial population density and its effect on the current Amazonian soil and forest structure, biodiversity and even some modelling of the global climate should be re-evaluated.

title: The first known cephalopod was only a millimetre long and lived about 520 million years ago
summary_zh: 已知最早头足类生物仅毫米大小。化石发现证实其存在。研究揭示头足类起源时间。
summary_en: The first known cephalopod was only a millimetre long and lived about 520 million years ago. Fossil discovery confirms its existence. The study reveals the origin time of cephalopods.
insights: 创新点：发现最早头足类生物化石
方法亮点：化石学研究揭示生物演化
关键发现：头足类起源时间早于预期
insights_en: Novelty: Discovery of the fossil of the earliest known cephalopod
Method highlight: Fossil study reveals biological evolution
Key finding: Origin of cephalopods earlier than previously thought
abstract: The locomotion of modern cephalopods, such as squid and cuttlefish, relies on buoyancy control achieved mainly by a specialized structure called a siphuncle. The discovery of fossils of Eoceras — a millimetre-sized cephalopod with a siphuncle — suggests that the group had already emerged in the early Cambrian, around 520 million years ago. Small shelly fossils show that cephalopods with siphuncle structures lived in the early Cambrian period.

title: Transcriptomic profiling of human brown and white adipose tissue depots
summary_zh: 分析人体脂肪组织的转录组特征。发现每个脂肪库具有独特的转录组特征和功能。人体脂肪组织间相似度高于与其他患者解剖和功能匹配的脂肪库。
summary_en: This study analyzes the transcriptomic profiles of human adipose tissues. Each depot has a distinct transcriptomic signature and functional profile. Human adipose tissues are more similar to each other than to anatomically and functionally matching depots in other patients.
insights: 创新点：揭示了人体脂肪库的转录组特征差异。
方法亮点：通过尸检组织分析不同疾病患者的脂肪库。
关键发现：人体脂肪组织间相似度高于其他患者脂肪库。
insights_en: Novelty: Reveals the transcriptomic differences among human adipose depots.
Method highlight: Analyzing adipose depots from autopsies of patients with different underlying diseases.
Key finding: Higher similarity among human adipose tissues compared to other patients' depots.
abstract: Abstract Human adipose tissues are solid organs distributed throughout the body in specific locations and are thought to have dichotomous functions: white adipose tissue stores triglycerides as an energy reservoir, and brown adipose tissue uses metabolic fuels to generate heat. To define the transcriptional profile of six principal adipose depots, we analyze tissue from 11 autopsies (3 F/8 M, 16-71 y) of patients who had different underlying diseases. Despite global similarities in terms of cell type proportions, each depot has a distinct transcriptomic signature and functional profile. Each human’s adipose tissues are more similar to each other than to the anatomically and functionally matching depots in other patients. The transcriptomic pattern of subcutaneous white adipose tissue can even be used to predict the human donor. This pattern suggests that individualized factors such as genetics, age, environment, diet, and disease play impactful roles in coordinating the behavior of the whole-body adipose tissue depot.

title: Assessing the influence of different alignment tools on the accuracy of a forensic epigenetic clock
summary_zh: 本文评估了不同比对工具对法医表观遗传时钟准确性的影响。方法上，使用四种不同的比对工具对法医表观遗传时钟数据进行比对。实验表明，比对工具的选择对时钟准确性有显著影响。
summary_en: This paper assesses the influence of different alignment tools on the accuracy of a forensic epigenetic clock. The method involves aligning forensic epigenetic clock data with four different bisulfite-specific alignment tools. Experiments show that the choice of alignment tool significantly affects clock accuracy.
insights: 创新点：评估比对工具对时钟准确性的影响
方法亮点：使用多种比对工具进行实验
关键发现：比对工具选择影响时钟准确性
insights_en: Novelty: Assesses the impact of alignment tools on clock accuracy
Method highlight: Uses multiple alignment tools in experiments
Key finding: Alignment tool choice affects clock accuracy
abstract: MOTIVATION: DNA methylation (DNAm) has long been a commonly investigated biomarker in biomedical research. The current gold standard for DNAm detection is bisulfite sequencing which requires dedicated alignment tools that can handle reduced sequence complexity. One commonly used application of DNAm are epigenetic clock measurements. These clocks have been adapted by many fields for their specific needs, including forensic genetics. Here, epigenetic clocks were designed to help estimate the chronological age of a biological stain donor for investigative purposes. RESULTS: In this study, data generated with a well established forensic epigenetic clock is aligned with four different bisulfite-specific alignment tools: 'Bwa-meth', 'Abismal', 'Bismark', and 'BS-Seeker2'. For each tool, we tested up to six different settings, altering parameters such as the maximum number of mismatches or the score function setting. The goal was to investigate whether the final predicted ages differed considerably between the tested alignment tools and settings. Quality controls such as read depth, precision, recall, F1 score, and alignment run time were also assessed. To allow other researchers to easily perform such methylation comparison analyses on their own data, a Shiny app called 'MethylAge Explorer' was developed within this study. None of the tested settings for the three alignment tools 'Abismal', 'Bismark', and 'BS-Seeker2' outperformed the originally used alignment tool 'Bwa-meth' in terms of age prediction accuracy. However, differences in final age predictions were observed between the different alignment tools. Therefore, it is necessary to be aware of which alignment tool to use for particular epigenetic clocks. AVAILABILITY: The data underlying this article and the code for the shiny app are available on GitHub (https://github.com/charlsut/methylage_explorer). SUPPLEMENTARY INFORMATION: Supplementary data are available at Bioinformatics online.
